baseline.description: Normal timetable with planned track and rake maintenance.

no_maintenance.description: No planned maintenance and no active condition alerts; timetable and crew planning still run.

planned_conflicts.description: Baseline scenario showing overlapping maintenance requests and train conflicts.

track_failure.description: Track-B signal failure triggers traffic-aware rerouting.

blocked_alternate.description: Track-B failure plus a halted consist on Track-C forces manual review.

condition_alert.description: Active asset alert generates urgent rake inspection during turnaround.

back_to_back_critical.description: Two critical condition alerts arrive close together; the optimizer sequences safe work and sends impossible cases to manual review.
